sql: SELECT l_shipmode, SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' OR o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_line_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority <> '1-URGENT' AND o_orderpriority <> '2-HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_line_count FROM orders, lineitem WHERE o_orderkey = l_orderkey AND l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP') AND l_commitdate < l_receiptdate AND l_shipdate < l_commitdate AND l_receiptdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND l_receiptdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY l_shipmode
